comment: Turret power, phase 1 (docs/design/TURRET_POWER.md sections 3, 6, 7, 10; designer decisions 2026-11-17 section 15). Read by PowerRules::GetTuning (Source/CodexTactics/Private/Power/PowerRules.cpp); a missing key keeps the code default (the same numbers). Phase 2 keys (sensor arc, lock-on, belt, siphon, hum noise for patrols) arrive with their code. Distances in metres, times in seconds, fuel in litres.

time.nominal_hour_real_s_comment: One nominal game hour of burn = 50 s of world time (the 20-minute day / 24). Frozen in the tactical pause (time dilation) and in turn-based combat.
time.burn_before_contact_comment: A generator running at level start (hostile / neutral) burns only after the squad first came within contact_wake_m.

generator.burn_comment: burn = base + per live turret on the network: 1 turret 1.25 L/h (one can = 6.7 min), 4 turrets 2.0 L/h (4.2 min).
generator.seize_dark_after_s_comment: A seize stops the generator after this long (its turrets go dark), then restarts it for the worker's side at seize_s.
generator.interrupt_reach_m_comment: The worker must stay this close to the generator box while he works; a move order, a knockdown, death or turn-based cancels the action (nothing moves).

noise.start_m_comment: A start / seize is heard this far (walls muffle it like footsteps): every patrol / guard that hears it comes to investigate (the stealth lure search).

network.plug_range_m_comment: A hand-placed generator links the nearest unlinked level turrets within this range (up to max_turrets) at BeginPlay; generated maps link by the props file.

knowledge.observe_s_comment: An operative of the squad standing still with a line of sight to a turret within observe_m for observe_s identifies its owner; the generator's panel identifies the whole network at once.

carry.jerrycans_per_operative_comment: Designer 2026-11-17 (question 5): one diesel jerrycan per operative, no movement penalty.

teams.hostile_owner_team_comment: The PMC team id that owns a generator running hostile at level start (TeamId 0 = the squad).
